name: website-to-figma
description: Local CLI that maps a small website into versioned JSON, plus a development Figma plugin that imports it as low-fidelity editable wireframes.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.plugin.json && tsc -p tsconfig.dom-tests.json
scripts.samples: tsx src/cli.ts fixture 5 --out samples/fixture-5.json && tsx src/cli.ts fixture 10 --out samples/fixture-10.json && tsx src/cli.ts fixture 20 --out samples/fixture-20.json && tsx src/cli.ts fixture hifi --out samples/hifi-synthetic.json && tsx src/cli.ts fixture hifi-states --out samples/hifi-states-synthetic.json && tsx src/cli.ts states-plan --plan samples/state-plan.example.json --out samples/state-plan.example.preview.json && tsx src/cli.ts states-plan --plan samples/state-plan.bootslander.json --out samples/state-plan.bootslander.preview.json
